02 / How I work

The build starts
with a better question.

The software matters. So do the process it fits into and the people who will use it.

01 — Discover

Find the real constraint.

Talk to the team, map the workflow, and turn an ambiguous request into a problem worth solving.

02 — Build

Connect reasoning to action.

Use Python, APIs, and agent workflows to ship a useful system, with explicit checks around model output.

03 — Enable

Make it usable without me.

Explain the decisions, document the process, and help the team own what happens next.

03 / A little context

Economics by training.
A builder by practice.

I’m interested in the space between what a business needs and what the technology can actually do.

I studied International Economics at UBC, then built Clarity Works to help non-technical teams develop practical AI capability. My work moves between client conversations, workflow design, Python pipelines, and hands-on teaching.

I build with Claude Code and Codex, work with Python and SQL, and have foundational TypeScript experience. My focus is understanding the logic, the failure modes, and the operational outcome.
